categories.main_business_segments: TSUTSUMI JEWELRY CO., LTD. is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and retail of jewelry, including necklaces, bracelets, rings, and other accessories. The company operates its own directly managed stores and also conducts wholesale business to select clients. There are no reportable business segments as all operations are focused on jewelry-related activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes continuous improvement in jewelry design and manufacturing, focusing on metallurgy and casting technologies to ensure stable quality and cost efficiency. It is also developing advanced stone-setting techniques and utilizes computer-aided design and automated wax modeling to quickly respond to market needs. Production is mainly in-house, with some manufacturing outsourced to a non-consolidated subsidiary.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TSUTSUMI's main customers are general consumers purchasing jewelry through its directly managed retail stores, as well as select wholesale clients such as department stores and specialty retailers. The company targets the domestic Japanese market, catering to a wide demographic seeking high-quality, reasonably priced jewelry.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in Japan, with 151 stores as of March 2025. Its retail network is concentrated in the Kanto region (94 stores), but also covers Tohoku, Chubu, Kinki, Chugoku, Shikoku, and Kyushu regions. All manufacturing and sales activities are domestic, with no overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: TSUTSUMI operates both upstream and downstream in the jewelry supply chain. It procures raw materials (precious metals and gemstones), manufactures finished jewelry products, and sells them directly to end consumers through its own stores, as well as via wholesale channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on enhancing customer satisfaction through attractive store environments and high-quality, competitively priced products. R&D efforts are directed at developing appealing designs, improving metallurgy and casting processes, refining stone-setting techniques, and leveraging digital technologies for design and rapid prototyping. Sustainability initiatives include energy efficiency, precious metal recycling, and environmentally conscious packaging.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from the sale of jewelry products through company-owned retail stores and wholesale to select business partners. Revenue is recognized at the point of delivery to customers. The company also earns minor income from real estate leasing and investment securities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: TSUTSUMI competes in the highly competitive Japanese jewelry market, facing both domestic and international brands. Its positioning emphasizes in-house manufacturing, high quality, and price competitiveness. While specific competitors are not named, the company distinguishes itself through its integrated production-to-retail model and extensive store network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the fiscal year ending March 2025, TSUTSUMI reported net sales of 24.8 billion yen, operating profit of 2.4 billion yen, and net profit of 2.0 billion yen, with a workforce of 878 employees. The company has demonstrated strong growth, with sales increasing 24.8% and net profit rising 71.9% year-on-year. It maintains a robust financial position with high equity ratio and no interest-bearing debt.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TSUTSUMI’s value proposition centers on delivering 'beauty, dreams, and satisfaction' to customers through high-quality, attractively priced jewelry. The company differentiates itself by controlling the entire value chain from design and manufacturing to retail, enabling rapid response to market trends, strict quality control, and cost competitiveness. Its focus on in-house production, store experience, and sustainability further enhances its brand appeal.
